page.overview:
What is Niko Angelov?

Niko Angelov is the Banu Haqim Primogen of Seattle. In his mortal life he was a soldier who fought in the Second World War.

Niko is wholly committed to living an honest life, to the point of barely being able to keep a single thought to himself. You can find him at Aurora Pawn surrounded by the trinkets of hapless mortals. He pleases the Court by sourcing rare artifacts and by taking on special tasks for the Prince. Equally, he infuriates the Court by refusing to deviate from using strictly honorable means in all his transactions. You might find that transparency helpful as you unravel the mysteries of the city, but be warned; he won't keep a secret, not even yours, so choose your words with care.

He represents his people among the Seattle Camarilla and grants murder contracts to the new Sheriff, the powerful elder known as Phyre.

Niko allows Patience Boswell because they like his collection and follow his rules. Patience claims the souls of the previous owners linger in the old items and give the artwork unique spirit. She also watches the shop for him when he's away in business and they have a "friends with benefits"-type relationship.
